# Just Doors

> Commercial, high-rise, multi-family, and residential door systems for the Lower Mainland of British Columbia: fire-rated door assemblies, architectural hardware, acoustic doors, and coordinated door schedules / takeoffs. Tagline: "No Windows. Just Doors." A division of Builderhaus.

## What Just Doors does
- Supplies and schedules door packages for general contractors, developers, architects, and property managers.
- Fire-rated assemblies (UL 10C / NFPA 80): 20-minute suite entries through 90-minute to 3-hour hollow-metal stairwell and shaft doors.
- Acoustic (STC-rated) suite-entry doors, architectural wood and aluminum doors, and Grade 1 hardware / closers / panic devices.
- Door schedules and takeoffs coordinated to local building codes and AHJ inspection requirements.
- Does NOT do windows — doors, frames, fire assemblies, hardware, and schedules only.

## Service area
Lower Mainland, BC — including Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Langley, White Rock, Delta, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, and Mission.

## Lower Mainland install partner
Rambo Wall & Ceiling (rambowalls.com) — door-niche installation across the Lower Mainland (fire-rated hanging, frame setting, hardware install). Phone: 778-773-2790.
